experiments.name: recency_trap
experiments.finding: RAG retrieval has systematic recency bias for temporal state questions

experiments.name: temporal_arithmetic
experiments.finding: LLMs systematically fail at date math; pre-computing at extraction time avoids this

experiments.name: knowledge_update
experiments.finding: Flat stores can't distinguish current vs historical states for same entity

experiments.name: context_efficiency
experiments.finding: PIE sends 96% less context but with 14x better signal-to-noise ratio

experiments.name: cross_session_synthesis
experiments.finding: PIE consolidates cross-session information into entities, eliminating multi-hop retrieval

experiments.name: temporal_ordering
experiments.finding: Temporal ordering is trivial with timestamps but error-prone with semantic search

experiments.name: entity_resolution
experiments.finding: Same entity referenced 7 ways across sessions; flat stores fragment, transitions consolidate

experiments.name: benchmark_gaps
experiments.finding: PIE should excel at knowledge-update (+30%) and temporal-reasoning (+40%) but may lose on single-session (-10%)
